description: This file defines the jQuery UI Menu widget version 1.14.1, including its initialization, event handling, menu item management, keyboard navigation, and submenu handling.

classes.name: ui.menu
classes.description: A jQuery UI widget that creates nestable, accessible menus with keyboard and mouse support.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the menu widget, sets up event handlers, and prepares menu items.

methods.name: _activateItem
methods.description: Handles activation of menu items on mouse events.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the menu widget, removing event handlers and attributes.

methods.name: _keydown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the menu.

methods.name: _activate
methods.description: Activates the current menu item, expanding submenus or triggering selection.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the menu structure, initializing submenus and menu items.

methods.name: _itemRole
methods.description: Returns the ARIA role for menu items based on the widget's role option.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Updates widget options, such as icons.

methods.name: _setOptionDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the menu widget.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses a specific menu item, updating ARIA attributes and scrolling into view.

methods.name: _scrollIntoView
methods.description: Scrolls the menu to ensure the active item is visible.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus from the current menu item.

methods.name: _startOpening
methods.description: Handles delayed opening of submenus.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Opens a submenu at a specified position.

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Closes all open submenus.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes a specific menu or submenu.

methods.name: _closeOnDocumentClick
methods.description: Determines if clicking outside the menu should close it.

methods.name: _isDivider
methods.description: Checks if a menu item is a divider based on its text.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses the current submenu and focuses its parent item.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the current menu item to show its submenu.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves focus to the next menu item.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Moves focus to the previous menu item.

methods.name: isFirstItem
methods.description: Checks if the active item is the first in the menu.

methods.name: isLastItem
methods.description: Checks if the active item is the last in the menu.

methods.name: _menuItems
methods.description: Returns all menu items within a menu.

methods.name: _move
methods.description: Moves focus in a specified direction among menu items.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Moves focus down a page of menu items.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Moves focus up a page of menu items.

methods.name: _hasScroll
methods.description: Checks if the menu has a scrollbar.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Triggers selection of the active menu item.

methods.name: _filterMenuItems
methods.description: Filters menu items based on typed characters for keyboard navigation.
